# Jejak: Potato House

South Jakarta, 11:00 PM. The Trail Group receives a single address: an old house that has been abandoned for decades. According to local residents, the smell of boiled potatoes still lingers around the house every night.

Enter the house, abandoned since 1942, with your friends. Solve puzzles using old letters and forgotten notes, then uncover the truth behind what really happened.

But be careful. There are still people guarding the house, both inside and outside.

🕯️ **Co-op Mystery Horror** for 1–6 players  
📜 Collect documents to piece together the true story  
🏃 Nowhere to hide. Running is your only option  
📖 Three different endings, depending on what you write in the journal

**Chapter 1 of the JEJAK horror anthology.**

A fictional story inspired by the atmosphere of Batavia during the Japanese occupation.
